title: ADFS Federation for Microsoft 365 — Deployment, Troubleshooting & Migration to Cloud Auth
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (enterprise Exchange/M365 messaging operations).

Exchange admin center / M365 admin center / Exchange Online PowerShell (EXO V3) / Microsoft Graph and on-prem Exchange Server + AD authored at exact detail from Microsoft public docs; version-/plan-dependent behavior (Exchange Server CU, EOP vs Defender for Office 365 plan, EOA/auto-expanding archive availability, Commercial vs Government cloud) cited or flagged 'verify in your tenant/version', never invented. Third-party hygiene/archiving/gateway tools at the pattern level. Automation is PowerShell (EXO PowerShell / Graph) — no hardcoded credentials or secrets in code. No client names.
hook: Run ADFS SSO for Microsoft 365 — or retire it to cloud auth cleanly
problem: Many enterprises still sign in to Microsoft 365 through ADFS — and it's a single point of failure that's often better replaced by cloud authentication. This solution covers both: deploy and troubleshoot ADFS federation (claims rules, token-signing certs, WAP proxy, endpoints), and — when you're ready — migrate to managed authentication (Password Hash Sync or Pass-through Auth with Seamless SSO, staged rollout) and decommission ADFS — so M365 sign-in is reliable and, ideally, simpler.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — ADFS federation for M365 (claims, certs, WAP), its failure modes, and the managed-auth alternatives (PHS/PTA + Seamless SSO) with the staged-migration model.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (ADFS/WAP + AD, Azure AD Connect, Global Admin, certificates, pilot group).

Implementation Guide — validate/repair ADFS (claims rules, token-signing cert rollover, endpoints, WAP), OR run the staged conversion to PHS/PTA + Seamless SSO (staged rollout, verify, convert domains) and decommission ADFS — pilot-first with rollback.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Exchange Online PowerShell (EXO V3) / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (federated/managed sign-in works, cert health, staged rollout verified) plus Best Practices for resilient M365 authentication.
short: Deploy/troubleshoot ADFS federation for Microsoft 365 (claims, certs, WAP) and, when ready, migrate to managed auth (PHS/PTA + Seamless SSO, staged) and decommission ADFS — so M365 sign-in is reliable and simpler. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
